to ^8B4513Einbroch^000000,

Please ask me if you
have any questions.

欢迎来到钢铁之城^8B4513艾音布罗克^000000。
如果有任何问题，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于城市的西北部。
在那里您可以看到我们城市的骄傲——飞空艇。
请记住，搭乘飞空艇需要付费。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}可以说是艾音布罗克最重要的设施，位于城市南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}是我们最大的购物区，就在艾音布罗克中心的东边。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于广场东边，提供一流的住宿服务。
在那里，您可以舒舒服服地享受在艾音布罗克的时光~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于艾音布罗克的东北部。
往返这里和艾音贝赫的火车每天全天运行。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于广场北边。
您可以在那里购买自用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}是工厂的附属设施，位于艾音布罗克的西南部。

scripts.text:

on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
我会在您的小地图上标记{0}的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:

{0}位于艾音布罗克的东南部。
您可以利用他们的服务来强化装备。

on the 1st basement floor in the Blacksmith Guild.

您可以去找铁匠公会地下一层的^FF1493武器匠^000000——^FF1493曼萨曼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
You can find
the ^CD1039Eden Teleport Officer^000000

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Einbech^000000,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
欢迎来到矿业城镇^8B4513艾音贝赫^000000。
我们在这里为游客提供帮助，如果有任何问题，请随时向我们咨询。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} is located
in the southern part of
Einbech. It's a nice place
to relax after a long day.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}位于艾音贝赫的南部。
是忙碌一天后放松身心的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
You can find the {0} in the center of
Einbech. There, you can
purchase any tools you
might need for your travels.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
您可以在艾音贝赫的中心找到{0}。
在那里，您可以买到旅途中可能需要的各种道具。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} are
located in the northwest
and northeast parts of
Einbech. There, you can
take a train to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}位于艾音贝赫的西北部和东北部。
在那里，您可以搭乘火车前往艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0}, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}是艾音贝赫的主要产业，位于城镇的北部。
我们的矿石全都来自那里，不过魔物总是妨碍矿工们工作。
